name: USTX
oneLiner: USTX is a Brale-issued dollar stablecoin for settling tokenized stocks, ETFs and other assets on tx, live in the tx wallet since October 2026.
collateral: Pre-launch: tx promises full 1:1 backing for USTX issued by Brale. Brale's program-level policy specifies segregated reserves held separately from corporate assets, daily reconciliation and monthly independent CPA attestations, with reserves in US Treasury bills of at most 90 days, government money market funds and bank deposits. These issuer commitments do not establish USTX-specific allocations, custodians or a retrieved independent reserve report.
pegMechanism: Planned native USD settlement asset on tx, issued by Brale. Exact USTX mint and redemption eligibility, fees, minimums, timing and capacity are unpublished. Brale general terms restrict purchases and redemptions to qualifying accounts and permit suspension.
launchPhaseDetail: tx launched USTX on October 20 2026, issued by Brale and backed 1:1 by US dollar reserves; users mint it on the tx chain by depositing USDC from Ethereum, Solana, Base or Polygon. USTX is live, but Pharos tracks it pre-launch because no native asset address, decimals, supply figure, token-specific control and redemption terms, or price listing has been published, so it cannot enter runtime data. tx is not an authored supported deployment chain.

listingStatusReview.reason: Missing lanes: price and supply. CoinGecko has no tx USTX listing and no denom, contract or decimals is published.

milestones.title: tx announces native USTX issued by Brale

milestones.title: tx launches Brale-issued USTX
milestones.description: Brale announced that tx launched USTX on October 20 2026 as a native stablecoin for its tokenized asset marketplace, issued by Brale and backed 1:1 by US dollar reserves. Users mint USTX on the tx chain by depositing USDC from Ethereum, Solana, Base or Polygon. No contract address, decimals or supply figure was published.
